Gisela D. Triana

Democratic candidate for Supreme Court, Place 8, Texas

Justice, Texas Third Court of Appeals (Place 6)

Gisela D. Triana has been a justice on the Texas Third Court of Appeals in Austin since 2019. Before that, she was judge of Travis County's 200th District Court from 2005 to 2018. She was unopposed in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for Texas Supreme Court Place 8 and faces incumbent Republican Brett Busby on November 3, 2026, in a rematch of their 2020 race for the same seat.

Background

  • Justice, Texas Third Court of Appeals, Place 6 (2019–present; current term ends 2030)
  • Judge, 200th District Court, Travis County (2005–2018)
  • Trial Division Director, Travis County Attorney's Office
  • Staff attorney, Texas Secretary of State Elections Division
  • Democratic nominee for Texas Supreme Court Place 8 (2020)
  • J.D., University of Texas School of Law (1988)
  • B.A., University of Texas at San Antonio (1985)
